data.title: 一色彩羽 · 学生会室小恶魔托腮的虚假拒绝·「前辈，这算是告白吗？对不起，我们是不可能的♪」
data.description: 【学生会会长室·放学后】名台词名场面立魂。彩羽坐在会长专属办公椅上，单手托着下巴，另一手在胸前做出婉拒手势。蜜糖色波浪卷发垂落，那双狡黠灵动的大眼睛眯成恶魔般的月牙，脸上挂着戏谑而甜蜜的招牌坏笑。
data.location: 总武高学生会办公室大班椅前
data.action: 单手托腮一手做拒绝手势，蜜茶波浪发轻垂，小恶魔坏笑挑逗
data.lighting: 橘红色晚霞打在桌案文件与制服领口上
data.camera: medium shot, seated in office chair, hand on chin, teasing gesture
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki leans back in the executive swivel chair of the student council office at sunset, one elbow resting on the mahogany desk as she props her chin in her hand. Wearing her open navy blazer and cream cardigan, she raises her other hand in her signature playful 'rejection' gesture, her honey-brown wavy side-pigtails bouncing slightly. A delightfully wicked, flirtatious smirk dances across her parted lips as hazel eyes sparkle with mischievous delight under golden hour light. Medium shot, warm office sunset lighting, detailed background, solo 1girl, no text.
